    def _decomposed(self, patterns):
        """Inference over per-snapshot programs; None triggers the fallback."""
        inst = self.inst
        S, C, E = self.S, self.C, self.E
        k = self.k
        ncom = len(patterns)
        all_domains = frozenset(self.fault_domains)
        requirements = [all_domains - pattern for pattern in patterns]

        # Distinct requirement scopes per snapshot, one program each.
        ctx = z3.Context()
        scope_snapshot = []    # snapshot index of each scope
        scope_local = []       # snapshot program of each scope
        scope_prog = []        # program (base + requirements) of each scope
        scope_models = []      # a model of each scope
        scope_of = []          # pattern -> snapshot -> scope index
        scope_rows = []        # propagation rows of each scope
        scope_row_bounds = []  # aggregated row bounds by coefficient vector
        keys = {}
        for req in requirements:
            per_snap = []
            for si in range(S):
                sig = tuple(sorted(d for d in req
                                  if self.snaps[si].dom_obs.get(d)))
                index = keys.get((si, sig))
                if index is None:
                    local = _Snapshot(inst, si, ctx, 's')
                    formulas = []
                    for d in req:
                        formulas.extend(local.dom_obs.get(d, ()))
                    prog = _Program(ctx)
                    prog.add(local.base)
                    if formulas:
                        prog.add(formulas)
                    model = prog.model()
                    if model is None:
                        return None
                    rows, row_bounds = self._scope_rows(si, req)
                    index = len(scope_snapshot)
                    keys[(si, sig)] = index
                    scope_snapshot.append(si)
                    scope_local.append(local)
                    scope_prog.append(prog)
                    scope_models.append(model)
                    scope_rows.append(rows)
                    scope_row_bounds.append(row_bounds)
                per_snap.append(index)
            scope_of.append(per_snap)

        def scope_indices(si):
            return [j for j in range(len(scope_snapshot))
                    if scope_snapshot[j] == si]

        def scope_demands(index):
            return [scope_models[index].eval(v, model_completion=True).as_long()
                    for v in scope_local[index].q]
